A '''stun fence''' was a defensive emplacement surrounding the [[Technical Branch Outpost (Lotide)|Technical Branch Outpost]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lotide]]. It was three-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] high meshed fence that [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] anyone that came in contact with it.
